title: QUIC RFC 9000 0-RTT Packet Format Focused Proof Work Item
summary: Decompose RFC 9000 S17P2P3 0-RTT packet-format proof into focused requirement-home tests and canonical trace evidence.
planned_changes:
- Add 0-RTT packet test helpers for header-control bits, version-specific data, packet-number boundaries, and structurally valid packets.
- Add focused positive, negative, and edge requirement-home tests for 0-RTT long-header shape, first-byte bit fields, connection-ID length limits, Length varint boundaries, packet-number length validation, early-data emission ordering, ACK exclusion, and remembered-limit behavior.
- Update canonical S17P2P3 trace links and generated coverage triage.
verification_plan: Run a Release build, the focused S17P2P3 requirement-home filter, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, and validate SpecTrace JSON.
out_of_scope: Adding 0-RTT packet decryption/opening support beyond existing packet builders.
Completing all remembered transport-parameter violation policies.
Claiming broader S17P2P2 or S17P3 packet format closure.
completion_notes: Completed as focused proof decomposition over the existing parser and 0-RTT builder behavior.
